title: Test environment forwards secrets
description: tox.ini declares a `passenv` entry that hands credentials to the test process. A secret committed in this file is readable by everyone with repository access and lives on in history after removal. This rule reads a `passenv` entry that hands credentials to the test process.
remediation: Remove the literal, rotate the credential and inject it from the CI secret store at run time. Specifically: fix a `passenv` entry that hands credentials to the test process.
limitation: It matches a `passenv` entry that hands credentials to the test process in the parsed tox.ini; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
